Deyi Zhu 祝德艺

Ph.D. Student at Tsinghua University

Hi! I am a Ph.D. student at Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School, advised by Prof. Yansong Tang. Previously, I received my B.S. degree in Automation from Tsinghua University in 2025.

My research centers on computer vision and embodied intelligence. I am interested in building agents that can perceive, predict, and act reliably in the physical world.
